1. Find the chosen percentile of each channel over the whole image.
2. Decode it to linear light, if Linear light is on, and take the gains as its inverse.
3. Scale each channel by its gain, in linear light or on the encoded values.
4. Encode back to sRGB and clip to 0 to 255.
